overlay_git_config:
[core]
	repositoryformatversion = 1
	filemode = true
	bare = false
	logallrefupdates = true
	sparseCheckout = true
[remote "origin"]
	url = https://github.com/OmniNode-ai/<OMNI_CI_OVERLAY_REPO>
	fetch = +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*
	promisor = true
	partialclonefilter = blob:none
[gc]
	auto = 0
[includeIf "gitdir:/home/runner/actions-runner/_work/omnibase_infra/omnibase_infra/.ci-overlay-checkout/.git"]
	path = /home/runner/actions-runner/_work/_temp/git-credentials-8961a728-a560-4fe1-8c98-64480b114c56.config
[includeIf "gitdir:/home/runner/actions-runner/_work/omnibase_infra/omnibase_infra/.ci-overlay-checkout/.git/worktrees/*"]
	path = /home/runner/actions-runner/_work/_temp/git-credentials-8961a728-a560-4fe1-8c98-64480b114c56.config
[includeIf "gitdir:/github/workspace/.ci-overlay-checkout/.git"]
	path = /github/runner_temp/git-credentials-8961a728-a560-4fe1-8c98-64480b114c56.config
[includeIf "gitdir:/github/workspace/.ci-overlay-checkout/.git/worktrees/*"]
